A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (20 February 2023). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Dagobah-D-captainneeda-PC-Errata-2023-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Captain Needa (PC 2022 D-E1 card)]] (23 December 2022): The game text changes: “non-hit” becomes “non-'hit'”. The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels with the corrected text and the mark “D-E1” in the lower border.

The whole 2022 D-E1 card image and the whole 2023 D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
